summary: Hiker in Snowmass Lake area ~1 mile from Buckskin Pass summit at ~10,843 ft reported unable to keep water down, extremely weak, unsure could make it off the mountain; Flight for Life located/assessed the hiker and transported them from the backcountry; hiker declined further medical evaluation after the flight.
location: Snowmass Lake area, ~1 mi from Buckskin Pass summit
responding_agency: Mountain Rescue Aspen; Flight for Life Colorado
